sources.title: Tartan-IMU/TartanIMU · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: TartanIMU — Multi-Platform Inertial Foundation Model TartanIMU is a light foundation model for neural inertial positioning. Given a 6-axis IMU stream (3-axis accelerometer + 3-axis gyroscope), the network regresses per-window body-frame velocity; position is obtained by integrating velocity with the platform orientation. It is the model released alongside the IROS 2026 Tartan IMU Challenge.
